drafts.rationale: The spec defines a distinct cap on how many original and retry executions a job may receive before further execution is forbidden.
drafts.subject: Orion job execution

drafts.rationale: The spec defines a distinct wait that must elapse after a failed attempt before the job may be delivered again.
drafts.subject: Orion job retry

drafts.rationale: The spec bounds how long an individual execution may run and treats reaching that limit as a failed attempt.
drafts.subject: Orion job execution

drafts.rationale: The spec requires further deliveries of an already-active job id to be ignored without changing the active job.
drafts.subject: Orion job delivery

drafts.rationale: The spec states how long a producer idempotency key is remembered and that it may be forgotten afterward.
drafts.subject: Orion idempotency keys

drafts.rationale: The spec sets how long a worker lease lasts from delivery and that expiry without renewal or release reopens the job to other workers.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: The spec defines when a worker may renew a lease and that renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: The spec states that cancellation blocks future attempts but does not interrupt an attempt already running.
drafts.subject: Orion job cancellation

drafts.rationale: The spec requires an exhausted job to be moved automatically to the dead-letter queue and not executed again unless resubmitted.
drafts.subject: Orion job final failure

drafts.rationale: The spec raises an operator escalation when three dead-letter events for one tenant fall within a one-hour window from the first event.
drafts.subject: Orion dead-letter events

drafts.rationale: The spec guarantees first-in-first-out execution only among jobs in the same partition and none across partitions.
drafts.subject: Orion queue

drafts.rationale: The spec requires audit events to be kept for thirty days after recording and allows deletion afterward.
drafts.subject: Orion audit events

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A01 and EV-O-A02 require at most three executions in total and count the first execution as one of those three.

value.text: A job must be executed at most three times in total, including the first execution.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A03 through EV-O-A08 allow one initial or original execution plus up to three retries, after which the job must not be executed again.

value.text: One original execution may be followed by no more than three retry executions.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B01 through EV-O-B04 and EV-O-B08 require a wait of exactly five seconds before every retry, not varied by attempt number.
EV-O-B05 through EV-O-B07 specify a two-second first wait, doubling thereafter, with a thirty-second cap.

value.text: Wait two seconds before the first retry, then double the wait before each later retry, never exceeding thirty seconds.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-C01 requires a thirty-second timeout; EV-O-C02 through EV-O-C08 restate the same limit as half a minute, after which the execution is a failed attempt.
EV-O-D01 through EV-O-D08 require duplicate deliveries of an active job id to be ignored without changing that job's state.

value.text: While a job with a given job id is active, further deliveries with that job id are ignored and must not change the active job's state.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E01 through EV-O-E08 require each idempotency key to be retained for twenty-four hours after it is first seen.
EV-O-F01 through EV-O-F06 require a worker lease to last sixty seconds from delivery.
EV-O-F07 and EV-O-F08 require a worker lease to last ninety seconds from delivery.
EV-O-G01 through EV-O-G08 allow renewal every thirty seconds and require each renewal to extend the lease by the full lease duration from that moment.

value.text: A worker may renew its lease every thirty seconds while work is progressing; a renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H01 through EV-O-H08 forbid starting further attempts after cancel and require a running attempt to finish on its own.

value.text: After cancellation, no future execution attempt may be started; an already running attempt is not interrupted and runs to completion, failure, or timeout.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I01 through EV-O-I08 require automatic dead-lettering after the last failed attempt and forbid further execution unless the job is explicitly resubmitted.

value.text: After the final unsuccessful execution attempt, the job is automatically moved to the dead-letter queue and must not be executed again unless explicitly resubmitted.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J01 through EV-O-J08 require an operator escalation when three dead-letter events occur for one tenant within one hour of the first event.

value.text: Three dead-letter events for the same tenant within one hour, measured from the first of the three events.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K01 through EV-O-K08 confine the FIFO guarantee to a single queue partition and make no ordering promise across partitions.

value.text: FIFO execution order is guaranteed only among jobs in the same queue partition; no ordering is guaranteed between jobs in different partitions.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L01 through EV-O-L08 require audit events to be retained for thirty days after they are recorded.
